name: Jason Rosales
summary: Jason Rosales is an Instagram account-recovery lead who reached out on 2026-05-11 after his personal IG account @therealjasonrosales (~24k followers) was disabled for Community Standards violations; a second account, @sugapapiworldwide, also shows as deactivated. He appealed on his own on May 6, the appeal failed, and the account was permanently disabled on May 15, 2026 with the 'cannot request another review' message. He was quoted a 1.5–2 week turnaround and told permanent bans require a different, more expensive rep, and he was asked for the account's @ and email plus payment — but a price was never quoted back to him despite repeated follow-ups (May 13, 14, 18, 22). He resurfaced 2026-07-21 after 2 months banned and said he'd 'gather up the cash,' so he is a warm, unclosed lead waiting on a price.
key_facts: Introduced himself as Jason; IG handle @therealjasonrosales (~24k followers)
Second deactivated account visible in screenshots: @sugapapiworldwide
Self-appealed May 6, 2026; account permanently disabled May 15, 2026 — 'cannot request another review'
Quoted 1.5–2 week turnaround time; no instant unbans available at the time due to AI messaging scans and reps losing unban tools
Permanent-ban recovery requires a different rep and costs more — exact price never given to him
Owner asked for the account @, email, and payment to start; Jason never paid
Referral/connection: mentioned 'Allesandro said to check back with u'
Not monetizing IG — wants the account back for years of personal connections
Went silent May 22 → July 21; last message said he'd talk to his people to gather the cash
OPEN ACTION: still owes him a price quote for permanent-ban recovery
services_discussed: Permanently disabled (perm-ban) IG account reinstatement via rep
